japan/tokyo-free-observation-deck.name: Free city-view observation deck
japan/tokyo-free-observation-deck.description: Twin towers in Shinjuku with free observation decks about 200 m up, looking across Tokyo and, on clear days, to Mount Fuji.

image.title: File:Westward view from Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building 2024-09-05.jpg
image.author: Asanagi

japan/omoide-yokocho.name: Izakaya alley dinner
japan/omoide-yokocho.description: Tiny smoky lanes of yakitori stalls and standing bars, where you graze on skewers and share small plates.

image.title: File:Yakitori shop lanterns in Omoide-Yokochō, Shinjuku, Tokyo, Japan 2011 2 (7024865381).jpg
image.author: Yiannis Theologos Michellis

japan/meiji-jingu.name: Meiji Jingu Shrine
japan/meiji-jingu.description: A forested shrine for Emperor Meiji, reached by a long gravel path under giant torii gates: a quiet counterpoint to Harajuku next door.

image.title: File:Torii gate for the Meiji Shrine (14628328081).jpg
image.author: Mustang Joe

japan/harajuku-omotesando.name: Harajuku & Omotesando
japan/harajuku-omotesando.description: Teen fashion and crepe stands on Takeshita Street, then the tree-lined boutique avenue of Omotesando.

japan/shibuya-crossing.name: Shibuya Crossing
japan/shibuya-crossing.description: The scramble crossing where hundreds of people cross in every direction at once; best seen from above.

image.title: File:Shibuya scramble crossing during Halloween 2023, actually less crowded than usual, high police presence 2.jpg
image.author: Syced

japan/tokyo-sunset-deck.name: Sunset rooftop observation deck
japan/tokyo-sunset-deck.description: Time the visit for golden hour and watch the city turn from daylight into a sea of lights.

japan/tsukiji-outer-market.name: Fish market breakfast
japan/tsukiji-outer-market.description: Sushi counters and street snacks around the old fish market: rolled omelette, grilled seafood and fresh sashimi.

image.title: File:Sashimi at the Tsukiji Markets - Tokyo Japan (Unsplash).jpg
image.author: Jonathan Forage jonathanforage

japan/senso-ji.name: Senso-ji Temple & Nakamise street
japan/senso-ji.description: Tokyo's oldest temple, entered through the Thunder Gate and a lively shopping street of snacks and souvenirs.

image.title: File:Kaminarimon (outer gate), Sensoji Temple, Akakusa, Tokyo.jpg
image.author: Daderot

japan/imperial-palace-east-gardens.name: Imperial Palace East Gardens
japan/imperial-palace-east-gardens.description: The old Edo Castle grounds, with stone walls, moats and wide lawns. Free to enter and calm in the middle of the business district.

japan/ginza-depachika.name: Ginza department stores & depachika
japan/ginza-depachika.description: An upscale shopping district whose department-store basements sell beautifully packaged food: a good place for gifts and a picnic.

japan/fushimi-inari.name: Fushimi Inari torii gate hike
japan/fushimi-inari.description: Thousands of vermilion torii gates winding up a forested mountain. Walk as far as you like; it is quieter the higher you go.

image.title: File:Fushimi Inari Taisha- Part II - FushimiInari246.jpg
image.author: lumoplank

japan/gion.name: Gion evening walk
japan/gion.description: Wooden teahouses along Hanamikoji lane. With luck you will see a geiko or maiko on the way to an appointment.

image.title: File:JP 日本 Japan 京都 Kyoto Higashiyama-ku Gion 花見小路通 Hanamikoji Dori 10am morning June 2026 N13P 21.jpg
image.author: HAGAT hOMSZE

japan/arashiyama-bamboo.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
japan/arashiyama-bamboo.description: A path through towering bamboo that creaks and filters the light. Go early to beat the crowds.

japan/tenryu-ji.name: Tenryu-ji Temple garden
japan/tenryu-ji.description: A UNESCO-listed Zen temple with a 14th-century pond garden framed by the Arashiyama hills.

japan/kinkaku-ji.name: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
japan/kinkaku-ji.description: A Zen temple whose upper floors are covered in gold leaf, reflected in a mirror pond.

japan/ryoan-ji.name: Ryoan-ji rock garden
japan/ryoan-ji.description: The famous dry garden of fifteen stones on raked gravel, made for quiet contemplation.

japan/nara.name: Nara day trip
japan/nara.description: Half an hour from Kyoto: free-roaming deer in Nara Park, the giant bronze Buddha at Todai-ji, and the lantern-lined paths of Kasuga Taisha.

image.title: File:Temple building, shrine, Rōben Sugi and deer below Nigatsu-dō, Tōdai-ji, Nara, 2016.jpg
image.author: DimiTalen

japan/kiyomizu-dera.name: Kiyomizu-dera Temple
japan/kiyomizu-dera.description: A hillside temple with a wooden stage jutting out over the trees, with views across Kyoto.

japan/sannenzaka.name: Sannenzaka & Ninenzaka lanes to Yasaka Shrine
japan/sannenzaka.description: Stone-paved lanes of traditional shops and tea houses, leading to Yasaka Shrine.

japan/nishiki-market.name: Nishiki Market tasting walk
japan/nishiki-market.description: A covered lane of about a hundred stalls selling pickles, tofu doughnuts, skewers and sweets.

japan/akihabara.name: Akihabara electronics & anime district
japan/akihabara.description: Multi-storey arcades, anime shops, retro game stores and themed cafes.

image.title: File:Sotokanda, Akihabara Electric Town at night 20231114.png
image.author: Phineyes

japan/hakone-open-air-museum.name: Open-air sculpture museum
japan/hakone-open-air-museum.description: Sculpture by Henry Moore, Picasso and others, set in a mountain landscape.

image.title: File:Aristide Maillol - Action Enchained - Hakone Open-air Museum.jpg
image.author: Jean-Pierre Dalbéra

japan/owakudani.name: Ropeway over volcanic valley
japan/owakudani.description: A gondola over the steaming sulfur vents of Owakudani, with Mount Fuji views on clear days. Try the black eggs.

japan/lake-ashi.name: Lake Ashi cruise
japan/lake-ashi.description: Sightseeing ships across a crater lake, with the red torii of Hakone Shrine on the shore.

japan/ryokan-kaiseki.name: Ryokan onsen & kaiseki dinner
japan/ryokan-kaiseki.description: Soak in the inn's hot spring bath, then eat a multi-course seasonal dinner in your yukata.

japan/dotonbori.name: Dotonbori street food evening
japan/dotonbori.description: Neon signs and canal-side food stalls: takoyaki, okonomiyaki and kushikatsu.

japan/pontocho.name: Riverside alley dinner
japan/pontocho.description: Narrow Pontocho lane and, in summer, the Kamo River terraces, lined with small restaurants.

japan/tea-ceremony.name: Tea ceremony experience
japan/tea-ceremony.description: A guided tea ceremony: whisk the matcha yourself and learn the etiquette behind it.

japan/nijo-castle.name: Nijo Castle
japan/nijo-castle.description: The shogun's Kyoto residence, known for the 'nightingale floors' that chirp underfoot and for its painted sliding doors.

japan/osaka-castle.name: Osaka Castle & park
japan/osaka-castle.description: A reconstructed 16th-century castle keep in a large park of moats and stone walls, with a museum inside and a view from the top.

japan/kuromon-market.name: Kuromon Market lunch
japan/kuromon-market.description: Osaka's kitchen: grilled scallops, sashimi and street snacks, eaten on the spot.

japan/shinsekai.name: Shinsekai retro district
japan/shinsekai.description: A retro district around Tsutenkaku Tower with kushikatsu restaurants and old arcade signs.

japan/osaka-sunset-observatory.name: Sunset skyscraper observatory
japan/osaka-sunset-observatory.description: Observation floors high above Osaka, best at dusk.

japan/himeji-castle.name: Optional: Himeji Castle day trip
japan/himeji-castle.description: Japan's best-preserved original castle: a white, multi-tiered keep nicknamed the White Heron.

japan/mt-fuji-five-lakes.name: Mt Fuji Five Lakes day trip
japan/mt-fuji-five-lakes.description: Lakeside views of Mount Fuji from Kawaguchiko and the Five Lakes area, clearest on early mornings.

japan/hiroshima-peace-park.name: Peace Memorial Park & Museum
japan/hiroshima-peace-park.description: The A-Bomb Dome, memorials and a museum that tell Hiroshima's story and its call for peace.

japan/shukkeien.name: Shukkeien Garden
japan/shukkeien.description: A compact landscape garden of miniature mountains and a pond: a quiet half hour near the castle.

image.title: File:Hiroshima Shukkei-en Pond.jpg
image.author: No machine-readable author provided. Fg2 assumed (based on copyright claims).

japan/hiroshima-okonomiyaki.name: Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki dinner
japan/hiroshima-okonomiyaki.description: Hiroshima's layered style: cabbage, noodles and egg built up on the griddle, unlike Osaka's mixed batter.

japan/itsukushima.name: Itsukushima Shrine & floating torii
japan/itsukushima.description: The shrine and its great torii gate, which seems to float at high tide.

japan/mt-misen.name: Mt Misen hike or ropeway
japan/mt-misen.description: Ropeway or hiking trails up to the summit, with views over the Seto Inland Sea and its islands.

image.title: File:Miyajima- Part III - Mount Misen - Miyajima512.jpg
image.author: lumoplank

japan/kenroku-en.name: Kenroku-en Garden
japan/kenroku-en.description: One of Japan's three great gardens, with ponds, stone lanterns and rope-supported pines.

image.title: File:Kenrokuen-Kanazawa-garden-01-2006-03-05.JPG
image.author: No machine-readable author provided. Jovandavid~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).

japan/kanazawa-castle.name: Kanazawa Castle Park
japan/kanazawa-castle.description: Reconstructed turrets and gates with white-walled storehouses, next to Kenroku-en.

japan/higashi-chaya.name: Higashi Chaya teahouse district
japan/higashi-chaya.description: Wooden teahouses on lattice-fronted streets; some serve tea and sweets topped with gold leaf.

japan/omicho-market.name: Omicho Market seafood breakfast
japan/omicho-market.description: The city's fresh seafood market, where breakfast is kaisendon, rice bowls piled with sashimi.

image.title: File:Omicho covered market western entrance, Kanazawa, 2016.jpg
image.author: DimiTalen

japan/kanazawa-21c-museum.name: Contemporary art museum
japan/kanazawa-21c-museum.description: A round glass museum with free public spaces and permanent works, including a pool you can look into from below.

japan/nagamachi.name: Nagamachi samurai district
japan/nagamachi.description: Earthen walls and narrow lanes of old samurai houses, a few open to visitors.

image.title: File:Tree - Nomura Samurai Family Residence - Nagamachi - Kanazawa, Japan - DSC00423.jpg
image.author: Daderot

japan/gold-leaf.name: Gold-leaf or craft workshop
japan/gold-leaf.description: Kanazawa produces nearly all of Japan's gold leaf. Try applying it to chopsticks or a small lacquer piece.

image.title: File:Kishi Ganku - Fusuma- Tigers and Dragon - Google Art Project.jpg
image.author: Kishi Ganku

japan/shirakawa-go.name: Shirakawa-go thatched-roof village
japan/shirakawa-go.description: UNESCO-listed farmhouses with steep thatched roofs. Walk the village, then climb to the viewpoint.

japan/takayama-old-town.name: Takayama old town stroll
japan/takayama-old-town.description: Preserved merchant streets of dark wooden houses, sake breweries and shops.

japan/hida-beef-ryokan.name: Ryokan onsen & Hida beef dinner
japan/hida-beef-ryokan.description: Soak in the ryokan's bath, then dine on Hida beef, the region's marbled local wagyu.

japan/takayama-morning-market.name: Riverside morning market
japan/takayama-morning-market.description: Stalls along the Miyagawa river selling pickles, fruit and crafts from early morning.

japan/takayama-jinya.name: Old town (Sanmachi Suji) & former government house
japan/takayama-jinya.description: An Edo-era regional government building you can walk through, a short stroll from the old town's sake breweries.

japan/nikko.name: Nikko day trip
japan/nikko.description: The ornate Toshogu Shrine and a forested temple complex, about two hours from Tokyo.

japan/itsukushima-night.name: Illuminated torii after day-trippers leave
japan/itsukushima-night.description: After the day-trippers leave, the torii is lit and the island goes quiet.

japan/hida-folk-village.name: Hida open-air folk village
japan/hida-folk-village.description: A hillside village of relocated thatched farmhouses, with craft demonstrations.

japan/hida-cycling.name: Countryside cycling tour
japan/hida-cycling.description: Rent bikes and ride between rice paddies and farm villages outside Takayama.

japan/kurama-kibune.name: Kurama to Kibune mountain hike
japan/kurama-kibune.description: A forest hike from Kurama temple over the mountain to Kibune, ending at riverside restaurants.

japan/philosophers-path.name: Philosopher's Path & Ginkaku-ji
japan/philosophers-path.description: A canal-side path lined with cherry trees, ending at the silver pavilion of Ginkaku-ji.

image.title: File:Japan Spring Down the Philosopher's Path (14164491752).jpg
image.author: Yiannis Theologos Michellis

japan.name: Japan
japan.description: An island country where ancient temples, mountain villages and neon cities sit within a short, superb train ride of each other.

images.title: File:Mount Fuji at sunset, March 2025.jpg
images.author: Romain Guy from San Francisco, USA

japan/tokyo.name: Tokyo
japan/tokyo.description: The capital: quiet shrines, enormous food scenes and distinct neighbourhoods from old Asakusa to Shibuya's neon.

images.title: File:Tokyo skyline 2.jpg
images.author: No machine-readable author provided. Ningyou assumed (based on copyright claims).

japan/kyoto.name: Kyoto
japan/kyoto.description: Japan's former capital, with more than a thousand temples, wooden machiya lanes and Gion's teahouses.

images.title: File:JP 日本 Japan 京都 Kyoto 東山區 Higashiyama-ku 清水寺 Kiyomizu-dera Temple red house n outdoor stairs June 2026 N13P 12.jpg
images.author: HAGAT hOMSZE

images.title: File:JP 日本 Japan 京都 Kyoto 東山區 Higashiyama-ku 清水寺 Kiyomizu-dera Temple red house n outdoor stairs June 2026 N13P 08.jpg
images.author: HAGAT hOMSZE

japan/osaka.name: Osaka
japan/osaka.description: Japan's kitchen: loud, friendly and built around street food, with a castle and a bright canal district.

japan/hakone.name: Hakone
japan/hakone.description: A mountain resort of hot springs, art museums and lake views, an easy overnight from Tokyo.

images.title: File:View of Mount Fuji from Onshi Hakone Park.jpg
images.author: Quercus acuta

japan/hiroshima.name: Hiroshima
japan/hiroshima.description: A city of peace memorials, a garden, and its own style of okonomiyaki, with Miyajima close by.

japan/miyajima.name: Miyajima
japan/miyajima.description: A sacred island with the torii that seems to float, friendly deer and a forested mountain.

japan/kanazawa.name: Kanazawa
japan/kanazawa.description: A well-kept castle town on the Sea of Japan, with a great garden, samurai lanes and gold-leaf craft.

japan/takayama.name: Takayama
japan/takayama.description: A mountain town of old merchant streets, morning markets and sake, in the Japanese Alps.

japan/shirakawa-go.name: Shirakawa-go
japan/shirakawa-go.description: A UNESCO village of steep thatched farmhouses in a deep mountain valley.
